$comment: A reword of support-v2-three-way-v1's routing question, written by hand against the routing family's development partition and against nothing else. The calibration partition scores it; the locked partition is not read.

This candidate changes the three criteria descriptions and leaves the instructions word for word. Its pair, support-v2-three-way-v3, changes the instructions and leaves the criteria alone, and support-v2-three-way-v4 changes both. Three candidates over two fields say which field carries an effect, if either does.

What it adds is the labelling rule the suite's items follow and the v1 text never states: a broken thing is technical even when it is an invoice or a checkout page, and a limit a larger plan would lift is sales even when it reads as slowness.

The option names billing, technical, and sales are frozen, as is the question type. Renaming an option changes the answer space rather than the question, and a candidate that returns different keys is not answering the same question.

routing.instructions: Which team should handle this message?

criteria.billing: Money already charged, owed, credited, or refunded: invoices and what is on them, payments, discounts, trials, and access lost over any of those
criteria.technical: Something does not work as designed: bugs, errors, crashes, outages, corrupt files, and slowness, including when it happens on an invoice, a payment page, or an upgrade button
criteria.sales: Buying or changing what they have: quotes, plans, seats, upgrades, renewals, pricing, add-ons, and a plan limit a larger plan would lift

severity.instructions: How severe is the reported issue?

urgency.instructions: Does this need urgent attention today?

criteria.true: Something is broken, blocked, or unsafe right now
criteria.false: It can wait for the normal queue
